Mussico Studio is a professional music academy in Virar offering offline and online music classes for kids and adults.

We provide training in Guitar, Piano, Singing, Classical Singing, Harmonium, Tabla, and Music Production for beginners to advanced learners.

Our academy has branches in YK Nagar and Bolinj, Virar West, with a focus on practical learning and personal attention.

Whether you want to learn as a hobby or pursue certified music education, Mussico Studio provides a supportive environment for every learner.

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Shaktia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Madam,

I wanted to express my gratitude for the wonderful experience my daughter had at your summer camp. She thoroughly enjoyed the dance, drawing, and craft activities provided. Each session seemed thoughtfully planned and engaging, allowing her to explore her creativity in various ways.

Moreover, I was pleasantly surprised by the level of personal attention she received. Despite the group setting, the instructors made sure to provide individual guidance and encouragement, which greatly contributed to her overall learning experience. Knowing that she was valued as an individual participant made a significant difference in her confidence and enjoyment of the activities.

Thank you once again for offering such enriching opportunities for children. We look forward to future programs and recommend your camp wholeheartedly to other families.

Sincerely
Yadvi's Father.

featured_reviews.review_text:

With a maximum of 2 students per online class, there is a focused and personal
attention on every student. I highly recommend joining his classes for anyone wanting to learn playing the Harmonica or the Tabla.

He has a simple and yet very effective style of teaching which goes well with all age category of learners and at any level of learning. I strongly recommend him for anyone wanting to learn the mouth organ and tabla.
